title: Normalized unit collection category definition (legacy units_collections_categories domain)
description: Contract for one normalized unit collection category: one stored legacy units_collections_categories object entry. The stored object key is the stable identity, so legacy_id is the key verbatim (rule N2); native integers are kept verbatim, localized names verbatim (uniformly-empty category_name_el preserved with a note), units integers validated against the normalized items set, and the single null costs preserved as null (rule N3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored units_collections_categories object key preserved verbatim (rule N2).

kind.description: Classification of the stored units_collections_categories domain: every entry maps to unit_collection_category.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets units_collections_categories).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets units_collections_categories).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

category_id.description: Native stored collection category id, kept verbatim (rule N3).

units.description: Native stored unit item ids, kept verbatim; every element must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule N3).

unit_refs.description: Resolved cross-domain item references: the units integers as legacy_id strings in stored order, each validated against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule N3).

rewards.description: Native stored rewards value, kept verbatim (rule N3).

cost.description: Native stored cost value, kept verbatim (rule N3).

costs.description: Native stored costs schedule, kept verbatim; null in exactly one stored entry (key 1), preserved as null with a manifest note, never defaulted (rule N3).

position.description: Native stored display position, kept verbatim (rule N3).

category_name.description: Collection display name, preserved verbatim (rule N3).
